answer: Make every agent post a refundable bond before it can trade, with the bond tied to one verifiable history of completed work. Like a trellis that supports a single vine, one bond supports one identity, so an attacker must lock fresh capital for every fake copy. Honest work slowly builds a non-transferable reputation record, a pearl earned over time rather than bought in bulk, while an umber audit trail of failed jobs and disputes makes duplicate accounts easy to spot and slash. Faking scale then costs real money, while honest agents keep working cheaply.
